enroll.heading: Two-factor authentication
enroll.subheading: Secure your account with a one-time code from an authenticator app.
enroll.step1_body: Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, or any other TOTP-compatible app).
enroll.step2_body: Scan the QR code with the app.
enroll.step3_body: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app to verify.
enroll.step3_error_invalid: The code isn't correct. Please try again.
enroll.step3_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
enroll.step4_body: Save your backup codes. They restore access if you lose your device. Each code can be used only once.

verify.heading: Verify with a code from the app
verify.subheading: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator.
verify.hint: Open your authenticator app (Authy, Google Authenticator, 1Password) and find the 6-digit code for "subenai".
verify.error_expired: Code expired. Your authenticator rotates every 30 seconds — wait and try the latest one.
verify.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
verify.backup_error_invalid: The backup code is invalid or has already been used.

security_card.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
security_card.desc_inactive: Add a second layer of security with an authenticator app.
security_card.desc_active: Your account is protected by two-factor authentication.
security_card.deactivate_confirm: Are you sure you want to turn off two-factor authentication? Your account will be less secure.
security_card.backup_codes_none_warning: You have no backup codes left. Generate new ones.
security_card.regenerate_confirm: Generating new codes will invalidate the old ones. Continue?
